title: Account offering match hypotheses
description: Evidence-linked candidate offering references for an account. These are hypotheses, not approved recommendations.

rationale.const: Caller-supplied mapping only; cited evidence records account activity, not offering fit.

enum: The offering vocabulary or entry is provisional and requires business review.
No offering-specific fit criteria or customer priorities were supplied.
At least one cited claim is marked as conflicting; it has not been resolved.
What outcome and constraints should be used to assess fit?
What scope, responsibilities, timeline, and measures of success should be confirmed?

claim_ids.description: Normalized claim IDs used to support the candidate offering; each must occur in the brief claims.

evidence_ids.description: Normalized evidence IDs; the current evidence contract uses claim_id for this ID, so this set must equal claim_ids.
